svg.title: Monk's hood cactus plant portrait
svg.desc: Photo-informed schematic of Monk's hood with a low angular star-ribbed green body, many fine pale flecks and sparse long straw-brown spines, in mixed mineral top dressing and an orange-brown faceted pot.
